# `schema_of_variant_agg`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the merged schema in the SQL format of a variant column.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.0 and later.

## Syntax

```text
schema_of_variant_agg(v)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `variant_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- schema_of_variant_agg, example 1
> SELECT schema_of_variant_agg(parse_json(j)) FROM VALUES ('1'), ('2'), ('3') AS tab(j);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

```sql
-- schema_of_variant_agg, example 2
> SELECT schema_of_variant_agg(parse_json(j)) FROM VALUES ('{"a": 1}'), ('{"b": true}'), ('{"c": 1.23}') AS tab(j);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.0.0.
